items.title: "Embarrassing": Dak Prescott's tunnel side-eye at a heckler
items.summary: After the Cowboys lost 24-16 at home to the previously winless Buccaneers on Thursday Night Football, a car service driver in the AT&T Stadium tunnel called the performance "embarrassing" as Dak Prescott walked by. Video of Prescott's long stare, his "You say that once I look off, huh?" reply and him asking staff to remove the man spread across X overnight. Fans split between "give whoever said that a raise" jokes and memes about the side-eye, and Prescott had to address it at his press conference.

items.title: Druski's "That's So Zion" former child star parody
items.summary: Druski dropped a two-minute sketch as Zion, the grown-up star of a fake Disney Channel sitcom called "That's So Zion", captioned "Kid stars grow up and be so unpredictable." Viewers immediately read it as Raven-Symoné, Orlando Brown and JoJo Siwa rolled into one character. His Instagram comments filled with jokes that Raven would be coming for him next, while DJ Vlad complained that AI was used to recreate his voice.
